observations: Industrial-style standing fan with a white mesh cover over the head.
A red circular logo with 'OX' is visible in the center of the grill in photo 0.
The fan stand is a long, grey or greenish metal pole.
The base is resting on a cardboard box that also features the OX logo.
The item is assembled and located in what appears to be a furniture or appliance store.

claims.evidence: The OX logo is visible on the fan grill and the base box in photo 0.
The visible pole is grey or greenish, and the mesh cover is white; no brown components are clearly visible in photo 0.
The fan is assembled and on display; 'new' usually implies unused in original packaging.
The fan appears tall, but 8 feet is an extreme height for a standard industrial fan and cannot be confirmed without a scale.

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt, weak, or noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the fan running at all speed settings.

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit OX fan (common in this market).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification plate on the motor housing.

risks.risk: The oscillation mechanism may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan head rotating side-to-side.

proof_requests: Video of the fan powered on, cycling through all speeds and oscillating.
Close-up photo of the silver/black specification plate on the motor.
Photo of the fan next to a person or measuring tape to verify the 8-foot height claim.
response.reason: The brand and type are clearly identified from the photos. It can be priced at the worst-case value for a non-functional generic industrial fan until further proof is provided.
